summary: All 27 occurrences checked under breakfast homonym qrṭ2, stem III; no new stem or box is required.
The apparent milk-curdling proposal is withheld: formal transitivity alone is insufficient because explicit direct food lists occur in ordinary breakfast contexts.
Preterit l-series actors can be overt l-marked participants, including a coordinated group with a singular verb at 95/194. This does not motivate Preterit Intransitive.
Infectum-wa covers habitual meals and hypothetical meal sequences; its presence does not identify dairy processing.
qroṭən/qroṭno is a cognate meal noun; the reader correctly treats only the finite predicate as an occurrence. It is not an independently idiomatic light-verb construction.
Legacy prs17/11 versus supplied PrS7/13 is a citation-scheme concordance, not a demonstrated source error.
Ask the speaker whether maqərṭíwayna u+ḥalwayḏan at MAC Interview2/132 means milk processing or breakfasting on milk. Confirm lexical identity before publishing any curdling sense.
Check breakfast/waking order at 67/79 and the komaqarti spelling against the edition; do not reorder or normalize inherited text.
Confirm the legacy PrS reference concordance for the dervish example.
